title: Tianqi Lithium
summary: Chinese lithium producer with major Australian hard-rock and Chilean brine interests.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Tianqi Lithium owns interests in the Greenbushes hard-rock mine and Kwinana refinery in Australia and in Chilean brine operations, and sells battery-grade lithium products. Its economics are highly sensitive to lithium prices and to the ramp of its refining assets. The balance sheet has been stretched by acquisition debt.

Technology Exposure

  • Lithium concentrate and battery-grade chemicals
  • Australian and Chilean resource interests
  • Lithium refining

What To Watch

  • Lithium pricing
  • Refinery ramp and costs
  • Debt reduction

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
